observation.summary: readProgress validates lastResult field types but accepts semantically impossible reward/loss combinations.

evidence.statement: Fields are range/type checked individually; extracted/cleared/gained/lost/carried/bonus relationships are not checked.

hypothesis.cause: Persisted settlement validation lacks the same invariants produced by settleProgress.
hypothesis.prediction: Rejecting impossible reward/loss combinations makes corrupted settlement records fail closed without changing any valid settlement generated by current code.
hypothesis.falsifier: A current valid settlement is rejected or a contradictory record is still accepted.

candidates.reason: Matches current canonical writer semantics at the read boundary.
Would invent historical rewards/losses instead of failing closed.

implementation.summary: Validate persisted settlement reward/loss coherence and add one assertion inside the existing native loop case.

before.summary: Contradictory defeated result with gained reward can pass readProgress.

limitations: Persistence invariant only; no browser or combat-feel claim.

next: Inspect one separate hunt-selection invariant after merge.
